rule: No lane starts from an unfrozen contract. Ambiguities return to A1; lanes never improve a frozen spec.

package.import_isolation: the event-stream hot path (models, quality, replay, archive, bbo) must not import pandas, pandera, dvc or nautilus_trader at module import time; heavy interop lives in isolated modules (_pandera_spike.py, nautilus_bridge.py) and is imported lazily inside functions

field_rules.timestamps: exchange_time_utc_ns, receive_time_utc_ns, available_time_utc_ns are int UTC nanoseconds; naive/local/float timestamps are rejected at construction (TIMEZONE_NAIVE_REJECTED / MALFORMED_SHAPE); the three times are never aliases and may be equal only when independently evidenced
field_rules.decimals: price, quantity, bid_price, ask_price, bid_size, ask_size persist as canonical decimal STRINGS (fixed-point, no exponent form) plus explicit integer price_precision/size_precision (number of fractional digits); in-memory they are decimal.Decimal parsed from the string; binary float is forbidden in persisted canonical evidence (PRECISION_LOSS on float input that is not exactly representable at declared precision; float input is otherwise converted via Decimal(repr(x)) then validated)
field_rules.event_id: lowercase hex sha256 of the UTF-8 canonical identity string joined by 0x1F: schema_version|source_id|venue|instrument_id|event_type|exchange_time_utc_ns|receive_time_utc_ns|available_time_utc_ns|sequence_number|raw_sha256
field_rules.quality_status: enum VALID | SUSPECT | INVALID | QUARANTINED; no event is VALID merely because parsing succeeded
field_rules.reason_codes: sorted unique list drawn from reason_codes@1 only
field_rules.nulls: absent fields are explicit nulls allowed only per the event-type matrix

event_type_matrix.DEPTH_SNAPSHOT: RESERVED in @1 - constructing it raises UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE
event_type_matrix.DEPTH_DELTA: RESERVED in @1 - constructing it raises UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE

schemas.sequence_number: int >= 0; null only when the source manifest declares sequence_semantics=NONE
schemas.raw_id: opaque source-record identifier string; raw_sha256 = sha256 of the raw provider record bytes (hex)
schemas.manifest_rules: manifest_id = sha256 of canonical_json(manifest minus manifest_id field); prev/next linkage nullable; completeness_status in {COMPLETE, GAPS_PRESENT}; gap_reasons list of reason codes; allowed_use_classification in {RESEARCH_AUTHORIZED, RESEARCH_CONDITIONAL, NOT_AUTHORIZED}
schemas.canonical_json: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False); decimals as strings per field_rules; replay stream = newline-delimited canonical_json per event

semantics.SEQUENCE_GAP: raised only when the chunk manifest declares sequence_semantics=CONTIGUOUS; with sequence_semantics=NONE a jump is not missing data
semantics.OUT_OF_ORDER_DELIVERY: flagged only when manifest declares ordered_delivery=true; replay sorting is deterministic and never deletes
semantics.CROSSED_QUOTE: bid_price >= ask_price inside ONE venue+instrument quote; cross-venue price disagreement is recorded by consolidated BBO contributors, never coded CROSSED_QUOTE
semantics.STATISTICAL_ANOMALY: diagnostic only, never silent deletion; default rule set flags |z|>6 on log price change within instrument and event class
semantics.STALE_QUOTE: quote whose exchange_time is older than the staleness threshold parameter at evaluation time; threshold is always an explicit input

write_sequence: write chunk bytes to sibling temp file .tmp-<pid>-<monotonic counter> in the SAME directory
re-read and verify sha256 + byte length + record count
only then publish the manifest atomically (same temp+fsync+replace)
archive_protocol.immutability: an existing content hash is read-only: re-put of identical bytes is a no-op; detection of DIFFERENT bytes at an existing content path is CORRUPTION (fail closed, HASH_DISAGREEMENT), never overwrite
archive_protocol.append_forbidden: no code path appends to a published .jsonl chunk
archive_protocol.orphans: chunk without manifest, or manifest without chunk, or trailing partial record => quarantined/diagnosed, never guessed complete
archive_protocol.manifest_publication_failure: chunk left in place, run ends with explicit orphan record; recovery runbook handles re-publication after human verification

replay_contract.tie_break: event_id is the final total tie-break; order is total, stable and independent of input file order
replay_contract.inputs: an explicit manifest ID list + predicate; replay records (manifest_ids, predicate_source) into its result; discovery of newer files is forbidden
replay_contract.digest: stream_digest = sha256 over the exact byte stream (canonical_json + newline per event); aggregate per-chunk digests recorded alongside
replay_contract.clock: clock speed affects waiting only, never event order or content; no wall-clock value enters event content
replay_contract.corruption: a corrupted replay record fails or quarantines visibly; except Exception: pass is forbidden

bbo_contract.venue_local: per venue+instrument: last non-stale quote wins; ties broken by (exchange_time, receive_time, event_id); contributes bid/ask/event_id
bbo_contract.consolidated: union of venue-locals whose venue is in permitted_venues and identity-compatible (same instrument_id, same currency); best_bid = max bid, best_ask = min ask; records contributing quote event IDs per side; a crossed CONSOLIDATED result is allowed and is reported as-is with contributors (it is information, not an error)
bbo_contract.staleness: staleness_threshold_ns is a required parameter of every evaluation call; no hidden default
bbo_contract.depth: L1 required; L2/depth optional and reports NOT_EVALUABLE unless proven snapshot/delta sequence semantics are supplied as input; synthesizing depth from bars is forbidden and tested against

tca_contract.inputs: fills (with side, price, quantity, fee, instrument, timestamps) + quote evidence + clock evidence; fills are input evidence, the plane never places orders
metrics: arrival_mid (bid+ask)/2 of the venue BBO at decision ts; consolidated fallback only if recorded
realized_spread_bps at frozen horizons H in [1000000000, 5000000000, 30000000000, 300000000000] ns = 2*side_sign*(fill-mid_at_fill_plus_H)/fill*1e4
tca_contract.separation: fees, funding and slippage remain separate columns before any total-cost view
tca_contract.not_evaluable: missing quote, clock, side, currency-conversion or fee evidence returns NOT_EVALUABLE for the affected metric; substituting zero is forbidden; currency mismatch without conversion evidence => NOT_EVALUABLE

mappings.QUOTE->QuoteTick: bid/ask Price and sizes from instrument metadata precisions (mandatory argument); ts_event=exchange_time_utc_ns, ts_init=available_time_utc_ns; no implicit now()
mappings.TRADE->TradeTick: price/size via instrument precisions; aggressor_side mapped when side present else NONE per nautilus enum
mappings.Bar: NOT mapped in @1: the plane has no canonical BAR event type; OHLCV can never become quotes or depth

rules: instrument metadata (precisions, instrument_id) is a mandatory bridge input
Decimal/fixed-point round-trips without precision drift (golden fixtures assert exact string equality after round trip)
INVALID/QUARANTINED events raise unless diagnostic_only=True is explicitly passed (then they are tagged, never silently streamed)
SUSPECT events stream with their status preserved in a sidecar list, not silently
no lookahead: the bridge never reorders, never substitutes timestamps, and mutation attempts are golden-tested
no strategy, risk, portfolio, broker or execution code is introduced
nautilus_bridge_contract.fixtures: provider-neutral synthetic examples for crypto trades, forex bid/ask, stocks trades/quotes; fixtures prove code semantics only and confer zero data authority
nautilus_bridge_contract.compatibility_path: A8 verifies constructor signatures against the installed 1.230.0 and records them; any irreconcilable difference => BLOCKED_COMPATIBILITY report to A1, no workaround imports

hypothesis_profiles.registration: tests/mdp_hypothesis/profiles.py registers 'mdp_ci' and 'mdp_deep' via settings.register_profile; conftest.py selects by HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE env var, default mdp_ci

mdp_ci.deadline_reason: deterministic CI on a shared host; per-test slowness is reported by the gate command instead

mdp_deep.deadline_reason: alone-running optional gate; seed/host/elapsed recorded in the result JSON

hypothesis_profiles.rules: profiles frozen here; every real counterexample becomes a committed golden regression fixture before its fix is declared; the terminal claim never rests on the Hypothesis example database alone; random tests touch no provider API, S1, raw licensed data, ledger, or orders

pandera_acceptance_criteria.spike_scope: batch/DataFrame ingestion boundary only; strict=True; no implicit column addition; coerce=False by default
adopt_requires_all: identical accepted/rejected row sets and reason attribution vs native frozen schema
deterministic errors independent of row order
no mutation of the input DataFrame
no unexplained runtime or peak-memory regression over 20% vs the native validator on the same fixtures
optional import isolation: event-stream hot path does not depend on pandas/pandera
pandera_acceptance_criteria.failure_verdict: PANDERA_EVALUATED_NOT_ADOPTED with the failing criterion recorded; that is a successful evidence-based decision and does not block MDP-V1

dvc_poc_topology.fixture: deterministic synthetic bundle: 32 files x 4 MiB = 128 MiB generated from a fixed seed by a committed generator script; bytes are non-proprietary and reproducible
dvc_poc_topology.remote: disposable local directory remote under the governance home OUTSIDE every git worktree (measured path recorded in run evidence only); tracked dvc config uses portable/relative settings, no host-private absolute path, no credentials
dvc_poc_topology.cache: default .dvc/cache inside the integration worktree, gitignored
proof_chain: dvc add bundle; raw bytes git-ignored; pointer + .gitignore tracked
dvc push to the disposable remote
create consumer: second temp clone of the integration branch; dvc pull
restored bundle SHA-256, file count, byte count, manifest and MDP replay digest equal producer
negatives: absent object, corrupted cache object, wrong pointer each FAIL VISIBLY, never fall back to newer/local data
dvc_poc_topology.non_roles: dvc never counts/executes/compares/ranks/publishes scientific trials; no dvc exp run, no metric ranking, no parameter sweeps; no owner data moved into DVC in this cycle

data_fusion_adoption.core_pick: research/data_fusion/** + tests/data_fusion/** from exact commit c6a0576ef98dd4392e90805c8ba33821da62eabc (see data_fusion_pin.json)

versioned_fixes.fix: date-only validity end resolves to next-day 00:00:00 exclusive instead of 23:59:59; fixture covers the sub-second boundary
versioned_fixes.attribution: recorded in file header and this freeze; original audited semantics referenced

versioned_fixes.fix: equal available_time+vintage with differing content raises a fail-closed conflict unless a preregistered authoritative revision key is supplied; silent later-retrieval preference removed; fixture covers both paths

data_fusion_adoption.boundary: MDP-V1 must not create a competing NormalizedRecord; market events reference Data Fusion evidence objects rather than duplicating them

exact_arithmetic_goldens: price 1e-8 and size 1e9 round-trip as strings at declared precision
bid 100.005 ask 100.005 => CROSSED_QUOTE reject; bid 100.005 ask 100.006 valid
mid of 0.00001/0.00002 computed in Decimal is 0.000015 exactly
float 0.1 input converts to Decimal('0.1') and passes; float 1/3 input fails declared precision 2 with PRECISION_LOSS
event stream digest is byte-stable across two processes and a detached worktree

benchmark_method.rule: correctness gates dominate speed; this is not an HFT claim and MDRAP benchmarks are never compared as equivalent
benchmark_method.fixture: frozen synthetic canonical stream committed as a generator script + recorded fixture sha256 (200k mixed TRADE/QUOTE events)
benchmark_method.procedure: 2 warmups + 7 measured runs; report median and p95 events/s, per-run wall time, peak RSS via resource.getrusage(ru_maxrss); host, python version, fixture sha recorded
benchmark_method.gate: no unexplained regression > 20% vs the frozen baseline run recorded at first PASS; fastest single run is never published

integration_order: P3: A2 -> A3 -> A4 cherry-picked in order with targeted tests after every pick
P4: A1 Data Fusion core pick + DF-ISSUE-1/2 versioned fixes; then A8 nautilus bridge from the new integration SHA
